content.text: I don't have tools to delete activities or reschedule workouts, but I can find both items so you can change them quickly in Garmin Connect.

I can't make either change for you. My access to your Garmin data is read-only, so I can't delete activities or move workouts. I found both items, so you can do it yourself in Garmin Connect.

**1. Delete yesterday's strength session**
- **Activity:** "Strength session" (ID 8880002), Tue 17 Mar at 07:10, 30 min, 160 kcal, average heart rate 101 bpm
- **How:** Open it in Garmin Connect, tap the ⋯ / gear menu and choose **Delete**.
- Your "Endurance ride" from yesterday evening (ID 8880001) won't be affected.

**2. Move tomorrow's threshold run to Friday**
- **Workout:** "Threshold intervals 5x6" (ID 7770002), Thu 19 Mar, about 80 min and 13.2 km
- **How:** In Garmin Connect, open **Calendar** and drag it from Thursday to Friday 20 Mar. In the app, you can also open the workout, remove it from Thursday and schedule it again for Friday.
- Your "Technique swim" will stay on Thursday unless you move it too.
- Nothing is planned for Friday yet, so the run won't clash with anything.

If you're following a Garmin Coach or adaptive training plan, the plan might not let you move the workout, or it might redo your schedule when you do.
